content.short: We are a development crew that focuses on bringing Zero-Knowledge tech to Cardano
content.description: Zero-Knowledge is one of the key pieces of technology that will revolutionize the blockchain space in the upcoming years. As team we leverage this cryptography to bring new tools that will enable a wide range of novel use cases specially regarding privacy and scalability. Our goal is to empower the projects and communities with these tools and extend the current capabilities of the Cardano ecosystem.
